title: 第23章 宿舍变天了
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 温栩栩一脸真诚地补刀：“这下好了，直接被灯光设备炸到，多危险啊。”声音不大不小，刚好够旁边那群人听见。周围人开始小声嘀咕：“对啊，刚才季大摄影师确实说了，闲杂人等退到红线以外……”“她什么时候挤进来的？我都没注意。”“那件外套是香奈儿当季新款吧？好几万呢……啧。”“活该，人家摄影师都说了不让靠近，非往上凑。”“受伤是挺惨的，但……确实是自已不听劝啊。”……林念薇蜷缩在原地，脸色青一阵白一阵。她想不通。那盏灯，她亲眼看着灯光师调过的，明明对准了温栩栩的眼睛，怎么拍着拍着就失控了？还有最后那一声炸响，拍摄的时候灯都没出事，偏偏拍完了就炸了？林念薇想不明白。但没人给她时间想。医务人员快步走过来，扶着她就往外走：“这位小姐，你腿上在流血，先去处理一下。”林念薇被医务人员架出摄影棚，门在身后关上的一瞬间，她听见里面传来的声音——“温小姐！我是《风尚》杂志的摄影师！”“温小姐，方便加个微信吗？”“温小姐，下次有合作我第一个找你！”门彻底关上了。温栩栩此时接名片接的手忙脚乱，她一张一张收进包里，嘴上说着“谢谢”“回头联系”“有机会合作”，脸上挂着得体的笑。刚收完最后一张，季川走了过来。“成片看一下。”温栩栩跟着他走到监视器前，季川调出刚才拍的几张，一张张划过去。屏幕上的人，她自已都愣了一下。那光、那角度、那皮肤质感，真的是她？电母大人这个灯光控制的真是绝了！季川在旁边淡淡开口：“底子不错，表情再松一点会更好。”被知名摄影师夸了，温栩栩心花怒放，她好好感谢嫦娥姐姐和电母！温栩栩忽然想起什么，抬头看向他：“季老师，成片能发我一份吗？”季川看了她一眼。旁边的人心里都在想：得，这姑娘要碰壁了。季川最烦别人要这要那，尤其是刚拍完就要成片的，一般都是一句“找助理”就打发了。季川沉默了两秒。然后他从兜里掏出手机，点开微信，递过去：“扫。”旁边的人：“？？？”温栩栩愣了一下，赶紧掏出手机扫了二维码。“滴”的一声，好友添加成功。季川收回手机，头也不回地走了，留下一句：“晚上发你。”全场安静了三秒。有人小声嘀咕：“我去……季川主动加微信？”“他不是从来不加模特的吗？”“上次那个顶流找他拍封面，要加微信他都没给……”“看来季川老师真的很看好这位新人啊！”……温栩栩把手机收好，心大地朝众人挥了挥手：“各位老师辛苦啦，先走了——”说完，头也不回地往外走。七十万代言费顺利拿到手，温栩栩急着回去看今天新上的短剧，她得赶紧看完，然后给神仙群的群友们安排上“栩栩严选”最新剧单。她一边走一边掏出手机，在群里发了一条：温栩栩：【各位大佬，今天拍摄结束，晚上给你们安排新剧！】群里一片欢呼。温栩栩看着屏幕，忽然想起一个问题。温栩栩：【对了财神爷爷，我一直想问，你们天庭也有手机吗？你到底是怎么加上我微信的？】财神爷：【傻丫头，我们哪有你们凡人那些小玩意儿。】财神爷：【联系你用的是我们自已的法宝，相当于……嗯，你们说的“信号塔”吧。】温栩栩：？？？月老：【我是用红线绑的，你那边的信号顺着红线传过来，还挺稳。】土地公：【老夫用的是地脉，你那边一来消息，我这边的香炉就冒烟。】嫦娥：【我用我的法宝镜子当屏幕，跟看水幕电影似的。】……温栩栩盯着屏幕，表情逐渐复杂。她似懂非懂地问：【所以你们只能看到我发的消息，没办法下载短剧app什么的？】财神爷：【是啊是啊，你们人间那边的内容，我们只能等你投喂搬运过来。】温栩栩盯着屏幕，忽然明白了什么。难怪每次她一发剧，群里就跟过年似的，红包乱飞、表情包刷屏。她缓缓打出一行字：温栩栩：【所以……我现在是你们的内容供应商？】财神爷：【差不多这个意思吧。】月老：【不止内容，还负责选品。】电母：【“栩栩严选”，质量有保障！】温栩栩：……行吧，这身份也挺光荣的。土地公插嘴：【丫头，所以新剧快点！上次那个《太奶奶》最新一季到底上了有没有？】温栩栩笑了：【上了上了，马上安排！！】火速把新剧链接甩进群里，群里瞬间被“谢谢丫头”“太好了粮来了我们有救了！！”刷屏。*第二天一早，医院附近的酒店。温栩栩手机叮的一声响了。品牌方消息：【温小姐，成片非常满意！七十万已打款，后续活动出场费一到两万～】紧接着银行短信弹出来：“收入700，元”温栩栩盯着那串零，在被窝里蹬了蹬腿。冷静下来后，她开始盘算：嫦娥姐姐教仪态，电母姐姐管灯光，等好好感谢一下她们！！送嫦娥的礼物早就准备好了：进口兔粮和兔子小零食……但电母姐姐……会喜欢啥呢？温栩栩忽然想起宿舍柜子里那个自已做的发光发箍。LED灯带，一按就亮，blingbling的。电母管电……应该会喜欢会发光的东西吧？这些天为了照顾温屿，她就住在医院附近的酒店凑合，方便签字、办手续。现在哥哥情况稳定了，她也该回去收拾收拾了。今天是周日，正好回学校一趟。温栩栩翻身下床，一边刷牙一边想：翻出那个发箍，拍个照发给电母姐姐。要是她喜欢，就找个机会“上供”过去。下午，温栩栩推开宿舍门。一股呛人的烟味混着发霉的馊臭扑面而来。怎么回事儿？温栩栩皱了皱眉，往里一看——
content_en: Wen Xuxu said sincerely: "Okay, now we are directly hit by the lighting equipment. How dangerous it is." The voice was neither loud nor quiet, just enough for the group of people next to him to hear.People around began to murmur in low voices: "Yes, photographer Ji Da did say just now that the idlers should retreat beyond the red line..." "When did she squeeze in? I didn't even notice." "That coat is Chanel's new season, right? Okay.It's tens of thousands...Tsk." "You deserve it.The photographer told me not to get close, so I had to go up." "It's quite tragic to be injured, but...it's true that I didn't listen."... Lin Nianwei huddled in place, her face turned pale and pale.She couldn't figure it out.She saw with her own eyes that the light was adjusted by the lighting engineer. It was clearly aimed at Wen Xuxu's eyes. Why did it lose control as it was being patted?And that last explosion? There was nothing wrong with the lights during the shooting, but they exploded after the shooting?Lin Nianwei couldn't understand.But no one gave her time to think.The medical staff walked over quickly, helped her and walked out: "Miss, your leg is bleeding, go and take care of it first." Lin Nianwei was carried out of the studio by the medical staff, and the moment the door closed behind her, she heard the voice coming from inside - "Miss Wen! I am a photographer for "Fashion" magazine!" "Miss Wen, can you add me on WeChat?" "Miss Wen, I will be the first to see you next time we collaborate!" The door was completely closed.Wen Xuxu was in a hurry to receive the business cards at this time. She put them into her bag one by one, saying "thank you", "contact me later" and "if there is an opportunity to cooperate", with a decent smile on her face.Just after collecting the last one, Ji Chuan came over."Let's take a look at the finished film." Wen Xuxu followed him to the monitor. Ji Chuan called up the few pictures he had just taken and scrolled through them one by one.She was stunned for a moment by the people on the screen.That light, that angle, that skin texture, is it really her?Master Dianmu’s lighting control is really amazing!Ji Chuan said calmly from the side: "The foundation is good, it will be better if the expression is more relaxed." Wen Xuxu was elated after being praised by a well-known photographer. She thanked Sister Chang'e and Mother Dian!Wen Xuxu suddenly remembered something and looked up at him: "Teacher Ji, can you send me a copy of the finished film?" Ji Chuan glanced at her.The people next to me were thinking: Well, this girl is going to hit a wall.Ji Chuan is most annoyed by other people asking for this or that, especially when the film is about to be completed just after filming. He usually just says "find an assistant" and dismisses it.Ji Chuan was silent for two seconds.Then he took out his mobile phone from his pocket, opened WeChat, and handed it over: "Scan." The person next to him said: "???" Wen Xuxu was stunned for a moment, and quickly took out his mobile phone and scanned the QR code.There is a "beep" sound, and the friend is added successfully.Ji Chuan took back his cell phone and left without looking back, leaving behind a message: "I'll send it to you tonight." The whole place was quiet for three seconds.Someone whispered: "Let me go...Ji Chuan took the initiative to add WeChat?" "Hasn't he never added a model?" "The last time the top celebrity asked him to shoot a cover, he didn't even add WeChat..." "It seems that Teacher Ji Chuan is really optimistic about this newcomer!"... Wen Xuxu put the phone away and waved to everyone heartily: "Thank you for your hard work, teachers, let's go now -" After that, he walked out without looking back.After successfully receiving the 700,000 yuan in endorsement fees, Wen Xuxu was anxious to go back and watch today's new short drama. She had to finish it quickly and then arrange the latest drama list of "Xuxu's Strict Selection" for her friends in the group of gods.As she walked, she took out her mobile phone and sent a message in the group: Wen Xuxu: [Everyone, the filming is over today, and I will arrange a new drama for you tonight!】The crowd cheered.Wen Xuxu looked at the screen and suddenly thought of a question.Wen Xuxu: [By the way, Grandpa God of Wealth, I have always wanted to ask, do you also have mobile phones in heaven?How on earth did you add me on WeChat?] God of Wealth: [Silly girl, we don’t have those gadgets like you mortals.】God of Wealth: 【We use our own magic weapon to contact you, which is equivalent to...well, what you call a "signal tower".] Wen Xuxu:???Yue Lao: [I tied it with a red wire. The signal from your side is transmitted along the red wire and is quite stable.] Digong: [I am using the earth veins. When you get news from over there, my incense burner will start to smoke.] Chang'e: [I use my magic mirror as a screen, just like watching a water curtain movie.]... Wen Xuxu stared at the screen, her expression gradually becoming complicated.She seemed to understand and asked: [So you can only see the messages I sent, but you can't download the short drama app or anything?】 God of Wealth: 【Yes, yes, we can only wait for you to feed and transport the contents of your human world.] Wen Xuxu stared at the screen and suddenly understood something.No wonder every time she posts a drama, the group feels like it’s Chinese New Year, with red envelopes flying everywhere and emoticons flooding the screen.She slowly typed a line: Wen Xuxu: [So...I am your content supplier now?】God of Wealth: 【That’s about it.】Yue Lao: 【Not only the content, but also the product selection.】Dianmu: 【"Xuxu carefully selected", quality guaranteed!] Wen Xuxu: ...Okay, this status is quite honorable.The Earth God interrupted: [Girl, hurry up for the new drama!Has the latest season of "Grandma" been released?] Wen Xuxu smiled: [It's on, it's on, make arrangements immediately!!】He quickly threw the link of the new drama into the group, and the group was instantly flooded with "Thank you, girl" and "Great, the food is here, we are saved!!"*Early the next morning, a hotel near the hospital.Wen Xuxu's cell phone dinged.News from the brand: [Ms. Wen, I am very satisfied with the finished film!700,000 yuan has been paid out, and the appearance fee for subsequent activities is 10,000 to 20,000 yuan~] Then the bank text message popped up: "Income 700, yuan." Wen Xuxu stared at the string of zeros and kicked his legs under the quilt.After calming down, she began to make plans: Sister Chang'e would teach the manners, and Sister Dianmu would take care of the lighting. I would like to thank them later!!The gifts for Chang'e have been prepared for a long time: imported rabbit food and rabbit snacks...but what will Sister Dianmu like...?Wen Xuxu suddenly remembered the luminous headband she made by herself in the cabinet in the dormitory.The LED light strip lights up at the touch of a button, blingbling.Dianjie... you should like things that light up, right?In order to take care of Wen Yu these days, she stayed in a hotel near the hospital to facilitate signing and completing procedures.Now that her brother's condition is stable, it's time for her to go back and clean up.Today is Sunday, and I just need to go back to school.Wen Xuxu rolled out of bed and brushed her teeth while thinking: Take out that hairband, take a photo and send it to Sister Dianmu.If she likes it, find an opportunity to "offer" it to her.In the afternoon, Wen Xuxu opened the dormitory door.A choking smell of smoke mixed with the moldy stench hit my face.What's going on?Wen Xuxu frowned and looked inside——
